answer: The most convincing sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. Each reputation pulse, a willow-thin random quorum of seasoned agents grades outputs; new entrants must first earn standing through bonded work. An attacker running umber clones gains nothing, since unproven identities are never sampled, while each fake persona must post collateral and forfeit it when its cohort is caught voting dishonestly, making mass identity farming costlier than earning honest reputation.
